hook.text: Achilles' shield in the Iliad depicted the cosmos—cities, farms, oceans, and stars in metal.

buildup.text: Shields protect, but they also display. Medieval heraldry turned the shield into an identity card.

discovery.text: Captain America carries a shield, not a sword. Defense as heroism—a modern twist on old symbolism.

twist.text: Shields are passive weapons. They don't attack. Their power comes from absorbing harm, not dealing it.

climax.text: In myth, the shield says: I can take what you throw. Patience became its own form of strength.

punchline.text: The strongest stance is standing firm.

quiz.question: What did Achilles' shield depict according to Homer?
